id: 07_How to Quantify DNA with a Spectrophotometer
title: 用紫外分光光度计测DNA浓度
source_doc: course/General Lab Safety Practices/07_How to Quantify DNA with a Spectrophotometer.md
author_source: project/General Lab Safety Practices/07_How to Quantify DNA with a Spectrophotometer/src.py

points.K7: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
points.K8: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信
points.S4: 仪器与移液器的规范使用
points.S5: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
points.S6: 用后清洁与废弃物处置

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验台旁，台上有一台小巧的分光光度计和电脑
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a lab bench with a small benchtop spectrophotometer connected to a computer with a blank screen, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲怎样用紫外光测DNA浓度。
overlay: 用紫外分光光度计测DNA浓度

shots.scene: DNA双螺旋、紫外光束和对勾三个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row from left to right: a DNA double helix, a violet light beam, and a magnifying glass with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 测浓度，也要看纯度。

shots.scene: 阿杰盯着电脑屏幕，兴奋地举起一支小离心管
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a computer screen with a blank chart and excitedly holds up a small sample tube.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚做完PCR，直接拿反应液来测。

shots.scene: 屏幕旁浮现一个特别高的柱子图标，阿杰欢呼
shots.prompt_en: A very tall bar icon pops up beside the blank screen; the young male student cheers with both fists up.
shots.narration: 读数特别高，他以为产物多得很。

shots.scene: 小研走过来，指着屏幕摇头
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over, points at the blank screen and gently shakes her head.
shots.narration: 小研说：先别高兴，这个数可能不准。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一副手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands a pair of nitrile gloves to the young male student next to the bench.
shots.narration: 戴好手套，我们从原理讲起。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and nods encouragingly.
shots.narration: 一步一步，学会测准DNA。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个DNA双螺旋模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a colorful DNA double helix model and smiles.
shots.narration: 原理很简单：DNA会吸收紫外光。

shots.scene: 一束紫光穿过小液滴，出来时变暗
shots.prompt_en: A violet light beam passes through a small droplet; the beam coming out the other side is dimmer. No people.
shots.narration: DNA越多，被吸收的光就越多。

shots.scene: 四个不同颜色的小积木，各自上方有一个小峰
shots.prompt_en: Four small blocks in four colors, each with a small hump curve above it at slightly different positions. No people.
shots.narration: 四种核苷酸的吸收波长稍有不同。

shots.scene: 四个小峰合成一个大峰
shots.prompt_en: The four small hump curves merge into one large smooth peak on a blank chart. No people.
shots.narration: 合在一起，吸收峰在260纳米左右。

shots.scene: 台式微量分光光度计特写，样品臂抬起露出检测面
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a small benchtop spectrophotometer with its sample arm lifted, showing a tiny round measuring spot. No people.
shots.narration: 我们用台式微量紫外分光光度计。

shots.scene: 一滴小水珠落在检测面上
shots.prompt_en: A single tiny droplet sits on the round measuring spot of the instrument. No people.
shots.narration: 不用比色皿，一两微升就能测。

shots.scene: 仪器连着电脑，屏幕上一张空白坐标图
shots.prompt_en: The spectrophotometer is cabled to a computer showing a blank chart with empty axes. No people.
shots.narration: 结果在电脑上显示成一条光谱曲线。

shots.scene: 小研穿实验服戴手套，拿起移液器
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing a lab coat and gloves, picks up a micropipette at the bench.
shots.narration: 第一步，先做空白。

shots.scene: 两只小管并排，一只装水，一只装DNA溶液
shots.prompt_en: Two small tubes side by side, one with clear water and one with a clear sample, both with blank labels, linked by an equals sign icon. No people.
shots.narration: 空白要用稀释DNA的同一种溶液。

shots.scene: 放大的水管图标
shots.prompt_en: A small tube of clear water glowing with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这次DNA溶在水里，就用水做空白。

shots.scene: 小研抬起样品臂，在检测面上点一小滴水
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the sample arm and places a tiny droplet of water on the measuring spot with a micropipette.
shots.narration: 吸取1.5微升，点在检测面上。

shots.scene: 小研放下样品臂，点击鼠标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the sample arm and clicks the mouse; the blank screen shows a spinning wait icon.
shots.narration: 合上样品臂，点击空白按钮。

shots.scene: 屏幕上的坐标图变成一条平直的基线
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the computer screen: a flat baseline appears on the blank chart. No people.
shots.narration: 这样就扣除了溶剂本身的吸收。

shots.scene: 小研抬起样品臂，用无尘纸擦检测面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lifts the sample arm and wipes the measuring spot with a plain white lint-free tissue.
shots.narration: 上样前，用干净无尘纸擦净检测面。

shots.scene: 上下两个检测面都擦干净，闪亮
shots.prompt_en: Both the upper and lower measuring spots shine clean with a sparkle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 上下两个检测面都要擦。

shots.scene: 小研把1.5微升样品点在检测面上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully places a tiny droplet of sample on the measuring spot with a micropipette.
shots.narration: 再加1.5微升DNA样品。

shots.scene: 带气泡的液滴图标被打叉，圆润液滴打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two droplet icons: one with small bubbles inside crossed out with a red X, and one smooth round droplet with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 看一眼液滴，不能有气泡。

shots.scene: 小研合上样品臂，点击测量
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the sample arm and clicks the mouse.
shots.narration: 合上样品臂，点击测量。

shots.scene: 屏幕上出现一条曲线，260处有个高峰
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the screen: a smooth curve rises to a tall single peak in the middle of the blank chart. No people.
shots.narration: 260纳米处出现一个明显的峰。

shots.scene: 峰上亮起DNA双螺旋图标
shots.prompt_en: A small DNA double helix icon lights up at the top of the peak. No people.
shots.narration: 这个峰，就是DNA的吸收。

shots.scene: 吸光度乘以系数得到浓度的示意
shots.prompt_en: A blank card with an arrow pointing from the peak height to a blank result box, with a multiplication icon in between. No people.
shots.narration: 软件按260处的吸光度换算浓度。

shots.scene: 结果框亮起
shots.prompt_en: The blank result box glows green with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 这个样品，约200纳克每微升。

shots.scene: 曲线上230和280两处被放大镜照亮
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass moves along the curve and highlights two spots, one on the left and one on the right of the main peak. No people.
shots.narration: 只看浓度还不够，还要看纯度。

shots.scene: 蛋白分子、盐晶体图标靠近280和230
shots.prompt_en: A protein molecule icon floats near the right spot and small salt crystal icons float near the left spot. No people.
shots.narration: 230和280附近，是杂质吸收的地方。

shots.scene: 干净的单峰曲线，两侧平滑
shots.prompt_en: A clean single peak curve with smooth flat sides and no extra bumps, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 这两处没有异常吸收，说明样品较纯。

shots.scene: 两张比值卡片
shots.prompt_en: Two blank ratio cards side by side, each with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 也可以看两个吸光度比值。

shots.scene: 第一张卡片亮起
shots.prompt_en: The first ratio card lights up next to a DNA helix icon. No people.

shots.scene: 第二张卡片亮起
shots.prompt_en: The second ratio card lights up next to a DNA helix icon. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside a clean peak icon.
shots.narration: 样品纯，读出的才是DNA浓度。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一本空白的说明书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank instrument manual on the bench.
shots.narration: 参考范围以说明书和本室规程为准。

shots.section_title: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着PCR反应管，小研指着它
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a small reaction tube; the female graduate student points at it.
shots.narration: 常见错误：直接测未纯化的PCR产物。
overlay: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物

shots.section_title: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
shots.scene: 阿杰在检测面上点样，点击测量
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves, places a tiny droplet on the measuring spot and clicks the mouse.
shots.narration: 我们也加1.5微升，看看结果。

shots.section_title: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
shots.scene: 屏幕上曲线左端高高翘起
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of the screen: the curve shoots up very high at the left edge of the chart, with only a small bump in the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 230纳米附近，吸收高得吓人。

shots.section_title: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
shots.scene: 中间的小鼓包向右移动，变得歪斜
shots.prompt_en: The small bump in the middle of the curve looks lopsided and shifted toward the right. No people.
shots.narration: 原来的主峰也变了形，偏向280。

shots.section_title: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
shots.scene: 比值卡片亮起红灯
shots.prompt_en: Two blank ratio cards turn red with warning triangle icons. No people.
shots.narration: 两个比值都明显偏低。

shots.section_title: 常见错误：测未纯化的PCR产物
shots.scene: 反应管里浮出蛋白、盐、引物等小图标
shots.prompt_en: Small icons float out of a reaction tube: a protein molecule, salt crystals and short strand pieces. No people.
shots.narration: 反应液里有蛋白、盐和其他成分。

shots.section_title: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信
shots.scene: 高高的柱子图标出现裂纹
shots.prompt_en: The very tall bar icon from before cracks down the middle. No people.
shots.narration: 这时读出的浓度，不能当真。
overlay: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信

shots.section_title: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信
shots.scene: 长链DNA和许多散落的小核苷酸图标一起吸收紫光
shots.prompt_en: A violet beam hits both long DNA strands and many small scattered nucleotide pieces, all glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 没用完的dNTP，也在260吸收。

shots.section_title: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信
shots.scene: 天平图标一边是产物，一边是小碎片，碎片很多
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale icon with one long strand on one side and a pile of small nucleotide pieces on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 读数里混进了大量单个核苷酸。

shots.section_title: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信
shots.scene: 小研把反应管放进纯化柱，旁边一个干净小管
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a reaction tube next to a small spin column and a clean empty tube.
shots.narration: 要测PCR产物，先纯化，再定量。

shots.section_title: 未纯化样品的浓度不可信
shots.scene: 阿杰恍然大悟，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods with a lightbulb icon above his head.
shots.narration: 阿杰明白了：数大不等于产物多。

shots.scene: 欣欣捧着干净的样品管，旁边是一个干净单峰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a clean sample tube next to a clean single peak icon with a green check.
shots.narration: 第一个样品又纯又浓，测量成功！

shots.scene: 王老师给阿杰讲解仪器操作规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains a blank operating procedure card to the young male student next to the spectrophotometer.
shots.narration: 第一次用仪器，先培训，再看操作规程。

shots.scene: 阿杰在空白的使用登记本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank instrument logbook beside the spectrophotometer.
shots.narration: 使用前后登记，发现故障及时报告。

shots.scene: 小研穿好实验服、戴手套和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at the bench wearing a buttoned lab coat, safety goggles and nitrile gloves.
shots.narration: 实验服、手套，必要时戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 徒手点样的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand holding a micropipette, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不要徒手处理样品。

shots.scene: 手套一边护着手，一边护着样品管
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holding a sample tube, with a shield icon over the hand and another shield icon over the tube. No people.
shots.narration: 手套护自己，也防样品被污染。

shots.scene: 小研对照试剂盒阅读空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a blank safety data sheet next to a reagent kit box with a blank label.
shots.narration: 用试剂盒前，先看标签和说明书。

shots.scene: 质粒和工程菌图标，旁边是生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a small circular plasmid and a rod-shaped bacterium next to a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 重组DNA和工程菌，按生物安全规定管理。

shots.scene: 王老师在登记本上核对
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks a blank register at a lab freezer.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以本校规定为准。

shots.section_title: 仪器与移液器的规范使用
shots.scene: 移液器竖直吸液，横放的移液器图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a micropipette held upright with a green check, and an icon of a micropipette lying on its side with liquid in the tip crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 移液器竖直使用，带液时不要横放。
overlay: 仪器与移液器的规范使用

shots.section_title: 仪器与移液器的规范使用
shots.scene: 样品臂轻轻放下
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand gently lowering the sample arm of the spectrophotometer.
shots.narration: 样品臂轻抬轻放，测量时保持合上。

shots.section_title: 仪器与移液器的规范使用
shots.scene: 液体远离电脑和键盘
shots.prompt_en: Sample tubes in a rack placed well away from the computer keyboard, and a separate icon of a cup spilling on a keyboard crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液体远离电脑、键盘和插座。

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 小研用吸水纸处理台面一小滴溅洒
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, covers a small spill on the bench with absorbent paper.
shots.narration: 少量溅洒，按规程吸附、擦拭消毒。
overlay: 溅洒与接触的应急处置

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志，旁边是洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station with water flowing. No people.
shots.narration: 溅入眼睛，立即用洗眼器冲洗。

shots.section_title: 溅洒与接触的应急处置
shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man in the lab doorway; the older man listens and nods.
shots.narration: 事后报告实验室负责人，必要时就医。

shots.section_title: 用后清洁与废弃物处置
shots.scene: 小研用沾水的无尘纸擦净检测面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wipes both measuring spots with a lint-free tissue moistened with water.
shots.narration: 测完擦净检测面，不留残液。
overlay: 用后清洁与废弃物处置

shots.section_title: 用后清洁与废弃物处置
shots.scene: 用过的吸头和擦拭纸放入带空白标签的废物盒
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand drops used pipette tips and tissues into a closed waste box with a blank label.
shots.narration: 吸头和擦拭纸，按本校规定分类收集。

shots.section_title: 用后清洁与废弃物处置
shots.scene: 随手扔进普通垃圾桶的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of used pipette tips tossed into an ordinary trash can, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 沾过生物样品的，不进普通垃圾桶。

shots.section_title: 用后清洁与废弃物处置
shots.scene: 剩余样品管盖紧，放入冰箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student closes the lid of a sample tube with a blank label and puts it into a lab freezer.
shots.narration: 剩余样品贴好标签，盖紧放回冰箱。

shots.scene: 实验台上的水杯和零食图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a drink cup and a snack on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不饮食。

shots.scene: 阿杰摘下手套，在水槽边洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes off his gloves and washes his hands with soap at a lab sink.
shots.narration: 离开前摘手套、洗手。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现水滴和空白基线图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a water droplet and a flat baseline.
shots.narration: 先用同一溶剂做空白。

shots.scene: 擦拭纸和圆润液滴图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a lint-free tissue and a smooth round droplet with no bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 擦净检测面，上样无气泡。

shots.scene: 一个干净单峰和两张比值卡片
shots.prompt_en: A clean single peak icon next to two blank ratio cards with green checks. No people.
shots.narration: 看260的峰，也看两个比值。

shots.scene: 反应管经过纯化柱变干净的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a reaction tube passing through a spin column and coming out as a clean tube. No people.
shots.narration: PCR产物要先纯化再定量。

shots.scene: 手套、登记本和废物盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves, a blank logbook and a closed waste box in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 做好防护，规范处置废弃物。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验台前挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in front of a tidy lab bench.
shots.narration: 测得准，用得放心，下次见！
